title: Tamam alam me aaj matam
body:
Tamam alam me aaj matam
<<MINI>>
Tamaam aalam may aaj matam, hussain bekas ka ho raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
alam gharon may sajay huway hai, dilon may farsh-e-aza bicha hai
<<MINI>>
tamaam aalam may aaj matam, hussain bekas ka ho raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Siyah kapde siyah chadar, ghamon ki gardo ghubaar sar par
hai sogwaro'n kay ashk jaari, ke sani-e-zehra berida hai
<<MINI>>
tamaam aalam ...
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Na chashme purnam ho kyon sawali, juloos hai zuljanah khaali ke mera duldul sawar-e-maula, zamin-e-karbal may so raha hai
<<MINI>>
tamaam aalam ...
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Alam me mashq-e-sakina dekho, to momino bas yeh keh ke rolo
chacha bhatiji may kya hai nisbat, wafa-e-abbas kya wafa hai
<<MINI>>
tamaam aalam ...
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Hussain peeri may dil sambhale, ke dil se uljhi sina nikaale
jawaan beta lahu may dooba, zameen pe aedi ragad raha hai
<<MINI>>
tamaam aalam ...
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Na maar barchi dil-e-nabi par, abhi huway hai jawaan akbar
ye qatl jisko tu kar raha hai, yehi to ham shakl-e-mustafa hai
<<MINI>>
tamaam aalam ...
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Madinay walo khamosh rehna, ghareeb zainab say kuch na kehna
basa huwa ghar jo le gayi thi, wo karbala may ujad gaya hai
<<MINI>>
tamaam aalam ...
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Azaa-e-shabbir hai ibadat, janab-e-zainab ki hai amaanat
ye nauha tere qalam se mehshar, janab-e-zahra ki ek ataa hai
<<MINI>>
tamaam aalam ...
